exact_criterion: Core inclusion: AI-assisted code review and reviewer trust/usefulness evaluation.

exact_criterion: Core inclusion: LLM-based code review and trade-off-aware evaluation.

exact_criterion: Supporting inclusion: human-AI review workflow and reviewer burden/usefulness.

exact_criterion: Core inclusion: generated review comments, dataset validity, and mitigation trade-offs.
decision_rationale: Directly evaluates LLM-based curation of review-comment datasets across comment-quality dimensions, downstream comment generation and refinement, and the standardization-diversity trade-off.

exact_criterion: Supporting inclusion: human-AI review workflow and evaluator validity.

exact_criterion: Supporting inclusion: human-AI review workflow and reviewer burden/usefulness.
decision_rationale: Systematically codes practitioner discourse to build a causal theory of how coding agents change code-review load, quality, comprehension, and human control. It provides contextual workflow evidence rather than comment-level performance evidence.

exact_criterion: Core inclusion: LLM-based code review, structured diagnoses, and end-to-end evaluation.
decision_rationale: Introduces and evaluates an agentic code-review framework that produces accept/request-changes decisions and structured diagnoses for AI-generated pull requests, including end-to-end issue-resolution outcomes.

exact_criterion: Core inclusion: generated review comments and usefulness/actionability evaluation.

exact_criterion: Supporting inclusion: mitigation through gating and verification in a code-review workflow.
decision_rationale: Empirically compares human-gate and AI-self-gate review filters in recursive code-model training, showing self-confirming approval can decouple acceptance from correctness. The evaluated artifact is generated code, not review comments.

exact_criterion: Supporting inclusion: human-AI review workflow and reviewer burden/usefulness.
decision_rationale: Wizard-of-Oz eye-tracking study evaluates how an LLM-generated label affects developers' review attention, time, and strategies; it does not assess generated review feedback.

exact_criterion: Supporting inclusion: context and reviewability support in code review.
